description: Month-by-month illustrative season panel for the Round 2 agent workspace (TDD-v2.1 center canvas 'season' stage). Ratings are derived directly from each gateway's data/routes/*.json bestMonths/shoulderMonths, not a separate weather dataset - no live weather API, no invented temperature figures.
